_comment_AppUrl: Base URL of the frontend app — used for email links, CORS, etc.

JwtSettings._comment: SecretKey must be at least 32 characters (256 bits). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

EmailSettings._comment: Use a Gmail App Password (not your regular password). Generate at: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

BlockchainSettings._comment_RpcUrl: Get a free Sepolia RPC URL from https://infura.io or https://alchemy.com — create a project and copy the endpoint.
BlockchainSettings._comment_AdminPrivateKey: Export the private key from your MetaMask wallet (the wallet that deployed the smart contract).
BlockchainSettings._comment_ContractAddress: The deployed smart contract address on Sepolia testnet.

CloudinarySettings._comment: Sign up at https://cloudinary.com — find credentials in Dashboard > Account Details.

OpenAISettings._comment: Get your API key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Model can be gpt-4.1, gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo, etc.

SePaySettings._comment_WebhookSecret: Set this to a strong random string. Must match the webhook secret configured in your SePay merchant dashboard at https://sepay.vn.
SePaySettings._comment_BankInfo: Your receiving bank account for VietQR payments. BankCode examples: MB, VCB, ACB, TCB, BIDV.
